faqs.question: What counts as a tracked prompt?
faqs.answer: One prompt × one AI engine × one daily run = one tracked prompt. A prompt monitored daily on ChatGPT and Perplexity counts as two tracked prompts. You can pause, resume, and swap prompts any time without overage charges.

faqs.question: What counts as a brand or workspace?
faqs.answer: A workspace is one brand and its variants — for example, a parent brand plus up to 5 sub-brands or product lines. Distinct brands, business units, or geographies belong in separate workspaces. Agencies use one workspace per client organization.

faqs.question: Which AI engines are included?
faqs.answer: Every plan includes all six: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews. We do not paywall engines or charge per-LLM add-ons. New engines are added at no extra cost.

faqs.question: What's the difference between For Brands and For Agencies?
faqs.answer: Same SolCrys platform, two ways to buy. For Brands gives a dedicated prompt allocation per workspace — predictable for in-house marketing teams. For Agencies gives a shared prompt pool that you can reallocate across client organizations as needs change, plus pitch projects (free 7-day prospect trials) and white-label deliverables.

faqs.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monthly plans cancel any time and stop billing at the next cycle. Annual plans can be cancelled, with the unused portion refunded prorated, no questions asked.

faqs.question: Do you offer a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes — when our self-serve product opens, every Brand plan includes a 14-day free trial with full access. Today, we offer a free AI Visibility Audit so you can see a sample report and decide before joining the trial list.

faqs.question: Do you support invoice, wire, or PO payment?
faqs.answer: Yes, on Brand Scale, all Agency plans, and Enterprise. Smaller plans are billed by credit card via Stripe.

faqs.question: Is my data private? Do you train models on my data?
faqs.answer: Never. Your prompts, brand context, and audit results are private and are never used to train any model. SOC 2 Type II audit is in progress, and we are GDPR compliant. Enterprise plans include a custom DPA and your choice of region.

faqs.question: Can I switch between monthly and annual?
faqs.answer: Yes. Switch from monthly to annual any time and we apply the discount at the upgrade. Switch from annual to monthly at the next renewal.

faqs.question: Do you offer a startup or non-profit discount?
faqs.answer: Yes. Verified seed-stage startups (under $5M raised, under 25 employees) and registered non-profits get 30% off any Brand plan for the first year. Apply via the contact form below.
